title: High-Yield Savings Accounts vs CDs: Where to Park Cash Safely
bigPicture: Both keep your money safe, but one lets you grab cash anytime while the other pays more if you wait.
whatYouNeedToKnow: High-yield savings accounts pay extra money the bank gives you, and you can take cash out anytime.
CDs pay more extra money, but you must leave it alone for a set time.
Both are safe up to $250,000 per bank, backed by the government.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Taking money out of a CD too early means losing some of that extra money.
Picking an account just because the rate is high without checking fees.
actionSteps: List how much cash you might need in the next 12 months.
Compare rates at your bank and online, then pick the best fit for your needs.
